name: field
title: Field
description: A form control with its label, description, and error, linked for screen readers.

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import "../core/vitehub.css";
import "./field.css";
import { Field as FieldPart } from "@ui-sdk/vue/field";
import type { FieldProps, FieldSlots } from "./types.ts";

const { invalid = false, disabled = false } = defineProps<FieldProps>();
defineSlots<FieldSlots>();
</script>

<template>
  <FieldPart data-slot="field" :invalid="invalid || undefined" :disabled="disabled || undefined"><slot /></FieldPart>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { FieldDescription as FieldDescriptionPart } from "@ui-sdk/vue/field";
import type { FieldDescriptionSlots } from "./types.ts";

defineSlots<FieldDescriptionSlots>();
</script>

<template>
  <FieldDescriptionPart data-slot="field-description"><slot /></FieldDescriptionPart>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { FieldError as FieldErrorPart } from "@ui-sdk/vue/field";
import type { FieldErrorSlots } from "./types.ts";

defineSlots<FieldErrorSlots>();
</script>

<template>
  <FieldErrorPart data-slot="field-error"><slot /></FieldErrorPart>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { FieldLabel as FieldLabelPart } from "@ui-sdk/vue/field";
import type { FieldLabelProps, FieldLabelSlots } from "./types.ts";

const { label } = defineProps<FieldLabelProps>();
defineSlots<FieldLabelSlots>();
</script>

<template>
  <FieldLabelPart data-slot="field-label"><slot>{{ label }}</slot></FieldLabelPart>
</template>
